class.name: SteamWorkshopSubscriptions
class.brief_description: Bounded list of subscribed Workshop item IDs for the current app.
class.description: The snapshot preserves Steam's subscription order. A truncated snapshot contains the first IDs that fit the requested limit.

method.name: get_published_ids
method.description: Returns decimal published file IDs in Steam's subscription order.

method.name: get_total_count
method.description: Returns the maximum subscription count observed while copying the snapshot.

method.name: is_truncated
method.description: Reports whether more subscriptions were observed than could be copied.
